headless.note: Source-only staging (--clone-only). The SNESRecomp CMake build compiles SDL3 as a static library inside the game build; there is no separate install step.

purpose: Canonical desktop host backend for the native game target: exact SDL 3.4.10 source matching the SNESRecomp framework pin. Staged offline from the repository-owned archive and consumed through SNESRECOMP_SDL3_SOURCE_DIR; the framework compiles it statically into the game executable.
